global.description: Helm's global values, shared with subcharts; Muster reads none of them.

tag.description: The image tag; empty uses the appVersion of the chart.

pullPolicy.description: The pull policy of the image.

imagePullSecrets.description: The Secrets for pulling the image from a private registry, as in a pod spec.

nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name in the names of the resources.

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the whole name of the resources.

replicas.description: The number of Muster replicas; one of them is the Leader at a time.

existingSecret.description: The Secret that holds the master keys and, under the keys named below, the password of the bootstrap Admin and the database password or URL unless database.existingSecret names another Secret. Required: the chart never generates the master keys.

masterKeysKey.description: The key of existingSecret that holds the master keys, one per line (MUSTER_SECRET_KEYS_FILE).

host.description: The database host (MUSTER_DATABASE_HOST); ignored when urlKey is set.

port.description: The database port (MUSTER_DATABASE_PORT); ignored when urlKey is set.

name.description: The database name (MUSTER_DATABASE_NAME); ignored when urlKey is set.

user.description: The database user (MUSTER_DATABASE_USER); ignored when urlKey is set.

sslmode.description: The sslmode of the database connections (MUSTER_DATABASE_SSLMODE); empty uses Muster's default, prefer.

existingSecret.description: The Secret that holds the database password or URL under passwordKey or urlKey, such as the app Secret that CloudNativePG generates; empty uses existingSecret.

passwordKey.description: The key that holds the database password (MUSTER_DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE), in database.existingSecret or, when that is empty, in existingSecret; ignored when urlKey is set.

urlKey.description: The key that holds the whole connection as a URL (MUSTER_DATABASE_URL), in database.existingSecret or, when that is empty, in existingSecret; used instead of the fields above.

sessionHost.description: The host of the session connection, for a pooler in transaction mode (MUSTER_DATABASE_SESSION_HOST).

sessionPort.description: The port of the session connection (MUSTER_DATABASE_SESSION_PORT); null uses the port of the main connection.

publicURL.description: The address of Muster for people and messengers (MUSTER_PUBLIC_URL).

ingestURL.description: The address Alertmanager sends its notifications to (MUSTER_INGEST_URL); empty uses publicURL.

bootstrapAdmin.description: The bootstrap Admin, created at start while the Organization has no Admin.

email.description: The email, also the login, of the bootstrap Admin (MUSTER_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL).

passwordKey.description: The key of existingSecret that holds the password of the bootstrap Admin (MUSTER_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE).

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables of the Muster containers, as in a container spec.

resources.description: The resource requests and limits of the Muster containers.

podSecurityContext.description: The security context of the pods.

securityContext.description: The security context of the Muster containers.

nodeSelector.description: The node selector of the pods.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: The topology spread constraints of the pods.

priorityClassName.description: The priority class of the pods; empty sets none.

serviceAccount.description: The service account of the pods.

name.description: The name of the service account; empty uses the full name of the release when the chart creates it, and default otherwise.

annotations.description: Extra annotations of the service account.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mounts the token of the service account into the pods; Muster does not call the Kubernetes API.

service.description: The Services of the three listeners.

app.description: The Service of the app listener: the UI and the API.

port.description: The port of the Service, also the container port and the listen port (MUSTER_LISTEN_APP).

ingest.description: The Service of the ingest listener: ingestion, Heartbeats and messenger callbacks.

port.description: The port of the Service, also the container port and the listen port (MUSTER_LISTEN_INGEST).

internal.description: The Service of the internal listener: the health checks and /metrics.

port.description: The port of the Service, also the container port and the listen port (MUSTER_LISTEN_INTERNAL).

ingress.description: The Ingresses of the app and ingest listeners; the internal listener is never exposed.

className.description: The class of the Ingresses; empty uses the cluster's default.

app.description: The hosts and tls of the Ingress of the app listener, as in an Ingress spec.

ingest.description: The hosts and tls of the Ingress of the ingest listener, as in an Ingress spec.

httpRoute.description: The Gateway API HTTPRoutes of the app and ingest listeners; the internal listener is never exposed.

parentRefs.description: The Gateways the HTTPRoutes attach to, as in an HTTPRoute spec.

app.description: The hostnames of the HTTPRoute of the app listener.

ingest.description: The hostnames of the HTTPRoute of the ingest listener.

serviceMonitor.description: A Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor that scrapes /metrics on the internal listener.

labels.description: Extra labels of the ServiceMonitor, such as the one the Prometheus selects.

enabled.description: Creates a NetworkPolicy that allows incoming traffic to the three listener ports only.

maxUnavailable.description: The number or percentage of pods that may be unavailable at a time.

alerting.description: The chart's alert rules about Muster itself, for the Prometheus Operator and the VictoriaMetrics Operator; send the critical ones through an Alertmanager route that bypasses Muster.

runbookBaseURL.description: The documentation site the runbook_url of every rule points into: this URL, then the major.minor of the appVersion (latest for any version that is not a release X.Y.Z), operations/runbooks/ and the name of the rule. Muster gets it too, as MUSTER_RUNBOOK_BASE_URL, for the runbook_url of its Internal alerts; set it here, not through extraEnv, so that the rules and the Internal alerts point into the same site.

jobSelector.description: The label matchers that select Muster's series, part of every series selector of every rule, such as job="muster"; empty selects the job named after the chart, or after nameOverride when it is set, which is the job the ServiceMonitor scrapes into.

prometheusRule.description: A Prometheus Operator PrometheusRule with the rules.

labels.description: Extra labels of the PrometheusRule, such as the one the Prometheus selects rules by.

vmRule.description: A VictoriaMetrics Operator VMRule with the same rules.

labels.description: Extra labels of the VMRule, such as the one the VMAlert selects rules by.

rules.description: Each rule: whether it is rendered, how long its condition holds before it fires (for) and its thresholds and windows.

MusterDown.description: A scrape target of Muster is down (critical).

for.description: How long the target is down before the rule fires.
How long no replica leads before the rule fires.

MusterDeliveryFailing.description: A Destination has queued deliveries and no successful delivery (critical).

for.description: How long the condition holds before the rule fires.

window.description: How far back a successful delivery counts.

for.description: How long the Destination is Broken before the rule fires.
How long the Integration is Heartbeat lost before the rule fires.

MusterDeliverySlow.description: The 95th percentile of delivery latency is above its objective (warning).

for.description: How long delivery is slow before the rule fires.

window.description: The window of the latency percentile.

MusterDeliveryQueueGrowing.description: A delivery queue is large and keeps growing (warning).

for.description: How long the queue keeps growing before the rule fires.

size.description: The number of waiting deliveries above which a queue counts as large.

window.description: The window over which the queue's growth is measured.

for.description: How long processing falls behind before the rule fires.

backlog.description: The number of waiting Stored Snapshots above which the rule fires.

delaySeconds.description: The 95th percentile of the processing delay, in seconds, above which the rule fires.

window.description: The window of the processing delay percentile.

MusterIngestRejected.description: Oversized or unauthorized ingestion requests arrived (warning).

for.description: How long the condition holds before the rule fires.

unauthorized.description: The number of unauthorized requests of an Integration within the window above which the rule fires; any oversized request fires it.

window.description: The window in which rejected requests count.

for.description: How long the condition holds before the rule fires.

window.description: The window in which template errors count.

for.description: How long the clock is off before the rule fires.

seconds.description: The clock skew against the database, in seconds, above which the rule fires.

for.description: How long the condition holds before the rule fires.

failures.description: The number of failed sign-ins of one method within the window above which the rule fires.

window.description: The window in which failed sign-ins count.

configMap.description: A ConfigMap with the dashboard for the Grafana sidecar, under the key muster.json.

labels.description: Labels of the ConfigMap besides the chart's; the Grafana sidecar finds dashboards by grafana_dashboard: "1" by default.

annotations.description: Annotations of the ConfigMap, such as the sidecar's folder annotation.

grafanaDashboard.description: A Grafana Operator GrafanaDashboard that imports the dashboard from the ConfigMap; it needs dashboard.configMap.enabled.

enabled.description: Creates the GrafanaDashboard; rendering fails without dashboard.configMap.enabled.

instanceSelector.description: The label selector of the Grafana instances that import the dashboard, as in a GrafanaDashboard spec.

folder.description: The Grafana folder of the dashboard; empty leaves it to the operator.

allowCrossNamespaceImport.description: Lets Grafana instances in other namespaces import the dashboard.

extraObjects.description: Extra manifests that the chart renders into the release, each a document of its own, such as the ExternalSecret or the SealedSecret that produces existingSecret. An item is a map, or a string that holds a YAML manifest; both go through tpl, so a manifest can name .Values.existingSecret and .Release.Namespace. A {{ meant for another tool, such as the template of an ExternalSecret, is escaped as ``{{ `{{ .password | urlquery }}` }}``; otherwise tpl renders it empty. Inside a map item, write the strings of an action with backticks: a map item is written back as YAML before tpl, which breaks lines longer than 80 characters at a space, and a double-quoted string cannot span that break.
